ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a single-input single-output block system, the input arrow on the left is labeled x(t), the output arrow on the right is labeled y(t), and the transfer function labeled inside the block is 1/(s+1). Reasoning: From the figure, H(s)=1/(s+1) can be read. The input is x(t)=sin(t)u(t), and the steady-state response is required, so it is only necessary to calculate the frequency response of the system at the sinusoidal frequency ω=1 rad/s. H(j)=1/(1+j), its magnitude is 1/sqrt(2), and its phase is -π/4. Therefore the steady-state output equals the input sinusoid multiplied by this magnitude and lagging by this phase, namely y_ss(t)=1/sqrt(2) sin(t-π/4).
